correctness.rationale: A balanced binary Hamming-weight circuit plus two fixed-threshold comparators uses fewer than 5km AND gates for k>=12 and computes exactly the same promise indicator. Padding gives exactly d=5km while retaining the final-gate convention. The Wang--Wu arithmetization applies to any ordered XOR/AND/NOT circuit of this form; the original field still gives soundness below 1/6, and their certificate-uniqueness and rectangle proofs remain valid. Substitution gives N=40k^2m^2-3km and the explicit near-square-root exponent. The finite artifact checks the component truth tables and representative parameter inequalities.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The 17 September 2026 Wang--Wu preprint uses a Theta(km^2)-AND exact-prefix-weight circuit and states only a polynomial rectangle exponent in the final input length. Targeted searches found no prior use of a linear-AND Gap-Hamming promise circuit in this construction or the resulting 2^{-Omega(sqrt(N)/log^2 N)} bound. The standard adder/comparator facts, fully linear PCP machinery, and qualitative separation are explicitly excluded from the novelty claim. The source's recency creates a material near-simultaneous-discovery risk.

value.rationale: The result removes one full factor of m from the certificate-driving circuit size, changes the construction's input scaling from Theta(k^2m^3) to Theta(k^2m^2), and yields explicit stronger lower bounds P^{NP^cc}=Omega(sqrt(N)/log^2 N) and P^{RP^cc}=Omega(sqrt(N)/log^3 N) while preserving the O(log N log log N) randomized protocol.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
